framePixel.rule: max channel delta of a rendered PNG (no codec) against the model, 8-bit sRGB, flat blocks only
framePixel.why: same tolerance as scripts/directed-scene-proof (texture filtering / sRGB round trips), used by the baseline phases

videoPixel.rule: max(|r-r'|,|g-g'|,|b-b'|) <= maxChannelDelta on every probe, decoded as BT.709 limited range
videoPixel.why: h264 crf<=18 + 4:2:0 at flat interiors; a BT.601/BT.709 mix-up moves saturated colours by >20 (negative control)

timing.frameCount: decoded frames (`-count_frames`) == requested frames, container nb_frames agrees when present
timing.fps: r_frame_rate and avg_frame_rate equal the bundle fps as an exact fraction
timing.duration: last pts + one frame period == frames * den/num within 1 ms; every pts delta is one exact frame period

identity.rule: a decoded frame is closer (mean abs probe delta) to the model's frame at the same index than to any other exported frame, applied only where the model itself keeps them apart by more than 3x maxChannelDelta

detail.rule: contrast = (mean Y of the columns that should be white - mean Y of the columns that should be black) / 255 over each stripe band of the decoded frame (1, 2 and 4 px stripes); a proxy (<= 3/4 resolution) drops 1 px contrast below 0.2

budget.rule: wall clock of the export op, SwiftShader GL, one run on an idle machine; per case in `cases`
budget.note: initial budget, not a promise of speed: the coordinator revises it explicitly, never silently

lossless or bit-exact frame equality: the codec is lossy; pixels are judged by probes, dense picture agreement and tolerances fixed in the corpus
domains the plan refuses (light, weather, effects, rigs, paths, data maps, splat): the corpus does not use them
